This page describes a valuation of the national flows of the [carbon sequestration](carbon.qmd) accounts at the social cost of
carbon of each country. It is a separate service of the tool, `carbon_cscc`, with its own workbook and report in
`outputs/carbon_cscc/`, and it leaves the carbon sequestration accounts and their products unchanged. The numbers and tables that a
run produces are in its report, which carries the same method text together with them.

{{< include ../../src/esa_toolbox/reports/carbon_cscc/methods.qmd >}}

# Code annex {#code-annex .unnumbered}

The service has one stage, which reads the national tables that `esa run carbon` writes to `work/carbon/tables/`, so the carbon
sequestration accounts run first. The service is opt-in, so `esa fetch`, `esa run`, `esa report`, `esa status` and the menu
leave it out unless a command names it, as in `esa fetch carbon_cscc` and `esa run carbon_cscc`. After a new run of the carbon
sequestration accounts, `esa run carbon_cscc --force` values the new flows.

## `fetch` {#code-fetch .unnumbered}

[catalog.py](https://github.com/renatovargas/esa-toolbox/blob/main/src/esa_toolbox/data/catalog.py), [fetch.py](https://github.com/renatovargas/esa-toolbox/blob/main/src/esa_toolbox/data/fetch.py) · `esa fetch carbon_cscc`

| Input | Source | Fetcher |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Country-level social cost of carbon, database version 2 | @ricke2019db | `fetch_cscc` |
| Harmonised index of consumer prices | @eurostat2026hicp | `fetch_eurostat` |

: Inputs of the valuation at country-level social costs of carbon. {#tbl-fetch}

`fetch_cscc` downloads the file `cscc_db_v2.csv` (27 MB) from the repository of the authors and keeps the rows of the reference case,
one for each country and one for the world (`WLD`), with the 16.7 percent quantile, the median and the 83.3 percent quantile. It
writes them to `store/cscc/cscc_reference_case.parquet`, records the date of retrieval, the address and the filter in
`extracts.json`, and removes the download. The fetcher stops if the reference case does not give exactly one row for each country.

## `accounts` {#code-accounts .unnumbered}

[tables.py](https://github.com/renatovargas/esa-toolbox/blob/main/src/esa_toolbox/services/carbon_cscc/tables.py), [accounts.py](https://github.com/renatovargas/esa-toolbox/blob/main/src/esa_toolbox/accounts.py), [workbook.py](https://github.com/renatovargas/esa-toolbox/blob/main/src/esa_toolbox/workbook.py) · `esa run carbon_cscc -s accounts`

Joins the values of the database to the Member States through their ISO3 codes in
[eu27_countries.csv](https://github.com/renatovargas/esa-toolbox/blob/main/src/esa_toolbox/params/eu27_countries.csv), converts them
to euros of 2023, and values the actual flow and the missed flow of `carbon_value_country_year.parquet` for each reporting year at
the three quantiles. It writes `carbon_sequestration_cscc_results.xlsx` to `outputs/carbon_cscc/tables/`, runs the checks, and
writes the facts and tables of the report.
